## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible behavior it affects.

## Rationale

Explain the scientific, correctness, compatibility, performance, or maintenance need.

## Implementation

Summarize the approach and any important design tradeoffs.

## Validation

List the exact tests and checks run. For result-affecting changes, describe the fixture and expected output. For performance changes, include the benchmark method and correctness comparison.

## Compatibility

Note any effects on command-line behavior, supported input modes, output format or ordering, Java compatibility, resource use, and parity with upstream UMICollapse.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for user-visible or architectural changes.
- [ ] Correctness was checked independently of any performance measurement.
- [ ] Performance claims include a reproducible benchmark and raw results.
- [ ] No sensitive, identifying, or proprietary data is included.
- [ ] No large data files, generated build products, or unrelated binary artifacts are included.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
